scope: NFL scheme-family reference and selection framework

families.name: Wide-zone/play-action family
families.identity: Stretch the front horizontally, create cutback conflict, and pair the run action with layered play-action answers.
weaknesses: negative plays when aiming points fail
adaptation_logic: change surface and motion while preserving blocking rules
reduce boot frequency against disciplined force players
nuance: personnel and motion can alter force responsibilities

families.name: Spread/RPO family
families.identity: Use width, formation multiplicity, and conflict reads to create an extra gap or leverage advantage.
adaptation_logic: change read key when defense rotates
limit tags when communication confidence is low
nuance: RPO legality and timing require rule-aware review
the same label may encode different reads

families.name: West-coast progression family
families.identity: Use timing, spacing, progression, and formation variation to create efficient completions and leverage answers.
nuance: progression depends on coverage and front
player-specific timing changes the viable concept set

families.name: Four-down single-high pressure family
families.identity: Present a defined four-man front and single-high structure while varying pressure and post-snap rotation.
adaptation_logic: rotate safety only when communication is confirmed
nuance: front label does not determine fit without technique and spill rules

families.name: Three-down simulated-pressure family
families.identity: Create four-man rush effects from varied second-level launch points while preserving coverage flexibility.
adaptation_logic: keep simulated-pressure menu small when personnel is inexperienced
pair each pressure with a coverage and protection answer
nuance: simulated pressure is a composition, not a single call
post-snap rotation changes the quarterback read

families.name: Match-coverage family
families.identity: Use zone-match rules to carry routes, close windows, and preserve leverage across formations and motions.
adaptation_logic: change match rules by formation and personnel
preserve force/fit responsibility when coverage rotates
nuance: match coverage labels conceal different pattern rules
formation and route distribution determine the actual responsibility

families.name: Gap/power and counter family
families.identity: Create defined surfaces and leverage conflicts through pullers, gap ownership, and constraint sequencing.
adaptation_logic: change surface without changing assignment language
reduce puller volume when penetration wins early
nuance: power and counter labels vary by puller and point of attack
front technique changes the correct fit and read

families.name: Pressure-and-coverage marriage family
families.identity: Pair pressure declarations with coverage structure so rush stress does not sacrifice leverage, fit, or communication.
adaptation_logic: limit pressure menu by communication confidence
pair every pressure with a run-fit and screen answer
nuance: pressure success depends on coverage and fit integrity
the same pressure label can launch from different second-level players
